H1.title: Fed decision days (statement days), split by the 2-yr yield's move that day

H3up.title: Dollar jumps: DXY ≥ +2% within five sessions (amended from 3%, prereg §4)

H3dn.title: Dollar drops: DXY ≤ −2% within five sessions (amended from 3%, prereg §4)

H4up.title: Rate shocks: 2-yr yield +25 bp or more within five sessions

H4dn.title: Rate shocks: 2-yr yield −25 bp or more within five sessions

H5.title: Regime label changes: first session of a new label
